not_completed_or_not_claimed: Complete full-resolution production tables and their interpolation gates were not run locally.
Coarse global tables test generation, storage, resume and lookup; they do not qualify rheology accuracy.
AR20 L12 is not degree converged at the failed pose; degree refinements are diagnostics, not independent accuracy references.
For h_eff/c < 0.5 the unchanged Hybrid V3 film plus two-anchor residual closure is retained; this is not a direct narrow-gap Stokes replacement.
AR2/5 original SIGBUS cause is unconfirmed. Private runtime copies and bounded recovery address tested failure modes; production-node remediation is not proven.
No full-table cluster run, MPI scaling, or new equilibrium bulk-viscosity measurement was performed.
AR20 uses an existing genuine L12 source fit retargeted to factor3; its unused far slot is the original near basis. AR2/5 target3 sources were generated with the modified generator.
Earlier O2 smoke/gate runs were explicitly interrupted to use the benchmarked native Release binary; they were not numerical failures.
